visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a bright red donation box labeled 'COFFIN DONATION BOX' in English and Thai. A man wearing a blue short-sleeved shirt with white bird patterns stands next to it in a semi-outdoor temple setting. Staff members in khaki uniforms are visible in the background processing paperwork. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a Thai-Chinese temple, showcasing golden altars, elaborate dragon carvings, and rows of lit red candles. Several visitors are seen walking through the temple and praying under bright indoor lighting. The atmosphere is vibrant with red and gold decorations. (3) The man in the bird-patterned shirt is shown striking a large golden bell with a wooden mallet in an outdoor courtyard. There are multiple bells hanging in a row. He then performs a ritual involving filling out pink forms and gold leaf sheets at a counter. (4) Close-up shots detail the man writing his name on a pink slip and then sticking it onto a large board already covered with hundreds of similar pink receipts. He also writes on a thin gold sheet and places it in a collection box. (5) Inside the main temple area, the man holds an orange receipt while praying with eyes closed. He then moves to a large metal incense burner and carefully burns the orange receipt in the flame. (6) The video concludes with a shot of colorful candles (yellow, pink, red) arranged on a table for sale. The man is shown one last time offering a traditional prayer with joined palms in front of the temple altars.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天帶你來曼谷 捐棺材積陰德. [Logo]: COFFIN DONATION BOX. 棺材捐款箱. (2) [Subtitle]: 其實已經不是第一次 到曼谷24小時的 義德善堂. (3) [Subtitle]: 不過因為很多人問我 要如何走完正確順序. (4) [Subtitle]: 趁著我這次回訪的時候 再來跟大家分享一次. (5) [Subtitle]: 義德善堂 主要是在幫窮困百姓. (6) [Subtitle]: 當發生不幸意外的時候 這裡的義工 都會第一時間到場處理後事. (7) [Subtitle]: 而他們的善款 就是來自民眾的愛心. (8) [Subtitle]: 因為泰國人相信 捐棺材 也是積陰德的方法喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 首先我們先填寫姓名還有金額 我是填寫英文的姓名 還有500元. (10) [Subtitle]: 金額不限 但我看網路上 建議500元為單位 也可收外幣. (11) [Subtitle]: 接著把粉紅色的收據 貼上牆壁即可. (12) [Subtitle]: 同時也可以填寫金片子 一張只要10元泰銖. (13) [Subtitle]: 寫上自己的姓名 再把它丟入箱子裡面 就可以囉. (14) [Subtitle]: 第二步 帶著橘色收據進入廟宇. (15) [Subtitle]: 很多人會順時針繞一圈 然後默念跟神明要說的話. (16) [Subtitle]: 最後再把橘色的收據燒掉 就可以囉 丟入桶子裡面. (17) [Subtitle]: 第三步 我們來到敲鐘區 先敲三下鼓. (18) [Subtitle]: 另外每一個鐘 都要敲三下. (19) [Subtitle]: 積陰德的同时 也可以祈求全家平安健康. (20) [Subtitle]: 最後如果想要買蠟燭的話呢 也可以在門口買蠟燭 進來參拜喔 分享給你們囉.
